scope: 2024 CCPC Harbin A B C D E G I J K L M
limitations: Independent small-case checks only; no online judge submissions or maximum-size runtime tests.

A.method: all accepted DAG paths for every interval in1..64, plus topological/source/sink/node/count checks on1000 full-range random intervals

B.method: all simple concave polygons over every vertex subset for random n<=7, plus rotating calipers versus all edge/interior-point pairs

C.method: relative-command simulator versus independent absolute displacement on random valid routes

D.method: all binary 2xn grids through n6: anchor/LCP-LCS interval criterion versus every right/down path and every square substring

E.method: actual truncated remove/multiply generating-function sweep versus exact rational median times for every starting-position assignment, including simultaneous events

G.method: all no-isolated graphs through n5 and all busy subsets versus exhaustive meeting-membership transitions, then replay every emitted invitation

I.method: small-factor grouped DP, sorted large-factor DFS and actual segment-tree joining queries at three thresholds versus all integer partitions of the target sum and multiset edit distance

J.method: next-recharge priority heap versus exhaustive per-kilometer choices of battery, retaining all reachable charge vectors

K.method: sorted prefix-capacity optimization versus every integral time allocation allowing at most one crop outside its bounds

L.method: all ordered pairs of actual path edge masks on random trees versus linear subtree-square aggregation

M.method: literal execution of the statement pseudocode for every b and n<=2000 versus divisor interval grouping
